cases.name: Jennifer June Brouwer Hoese
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "After graduating from Concord High School in 1995, she went on to attend the Elkhart Beauty School. She has worked as a beautician up until this year, when she decided to open Vitality and Motion LLC.

On May 4, 2007, she married Brian Hoese at a destination wedding in Jamaica. The two were inseparable, together they enjoyed fishing, and gathering with their friends at the local Niles establishments.

Jennifer was a very strong, independent, to the point kind of woman. If she felt something strongly, she let you know.  She enjoyed rooting on her favorite teams with her husband Brian, whether it was the Chicago Cubs, Chicago Bears, University of Michigan football, or the Iowa Hawkeye Football team. Jennifer loved to ride the Harley with Brian; they looked forward to supporting the Niles Burn Run every year.  She loved traveling and visiting new places, especially beaches."
cases.narrative: On 10/23/2022, neighbors noticed Jennifer in the back yard. When she hadn't moved, they went to check on her and discovered she was dead.
